_meta.note: The NASA storm images are real. The storm effect inside the game is a model, so show the DERIVED label next to game values (Part 5 wording note).
_meta.note_nasa: Game file. Numbers here are game values, not NASA data.

events.label: Global dust storm
events.inspired_by: 2018 Mars global dust storm (NASA PIA22737, PIA22487, PIA22519)

events.label: Rover finds ice
events.inspired_by: NASA says ice is near the surface in northern mid-latitudes (S12). Amount and chance are game values.

events.label: Solar particle event
events.inspired_by: NASA's Curiosity RAD results cover galactic cosmic rays and solar energetic particles (NTRS record, S23). The spike size is a game value.

tau_profiles.label: Stylized 2018-style storm
tau_profiles.provenance: GAME_VALUE (shape follows NASA's description; the numbers are ours)
tau_profiles.basis: NASA describes complex growth over the first month, near the peak for three weeks, then a multi-month decay (S07). The game squeezes this into hours and caps the peak at 4.0. The real tau at Opportunity reached about 10.8 (S05, S06).
